clips.title: The story
paras: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is a night elf sentinel stationed at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She is deeply troubled by the disappearance of Priestess Velinde Starsong and dispatches trusted Alliance adventurers to track down clues regarding her whereabouts. Through her inquiries, she seeks to piece together the unraveling mystery behind the Scythe of Elune.

Standing watch over Darnassus from the Warrior's Terrace, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver represents the vigilant military arm of the kaldorei. When Priestess Velinde Starsong mysteriously vanished without leaving word, Thyn'tel refused to let the trail go cold. Sensing that grave forces were involved, she takes it upon herself to commission adventurers willing to dig into the priestess's personal belongings and uncover where her journey led.
